listings.title: Marrow & Mint
listings.summary: A dawn bakery where the neighborhood starts with cardamom buns and strong coffee.
listings.description: Marrow & Mint is a small corner bakery with a short counter, an open bread room, and a sunny pavement bench. The daily menu follows the seasons and usually sells through before lunch.

profileValues.borough-city-guide.places.curator-note: Go before nine, take the window stool, and ask what just came out of the oven. The **cardamom bun** is the move when it appears.

media.alt: Marrow & Mint bakery glowing in early morning light on a neighborhood corner

listings.title: Atlas Books
listings.summary: A thoughtful bookshop for small presses, city histories, and letterpress finds.
listings.description: Atlas Books fills two old shop rooms with new fiction, field guides, art books, and shelves chosen by working writers. Hand-printed broadsides from the basement press change every month.

profileValues.borough-city-guide.places.curator-note: The staff shelf is consistently sharp. Look past the front table for local histories and the letterpress drawer beside the reading chair.

media.alt: Warm independent bookshop lined with books, prints, and houseplants

listings.title: Northline Gallery
listings.summary: A compact contemporary gallery that gives emerging regional artists room to breathe.
listings.description: Northline Gallery presents six focused exhibitions a year in a former repair shop. Openings are lively, while weekday afternoons are quiet enough to spend time with the work.

profileValues.borough-city-guide.places.curator-note: Read the single-page exhibition note before walking the room. The gallery keeps it brief and it usually opens up the show without overexplaining it.

media.alt: Quiet contemporary gallery with paintings, a wooden bench, and a single visitor

listings.title: Common Thread Studio
listings.summary: A working ceramics studio with open shelves, small classes, and local clay.
listings.description: Common Thread is equal parts neighborhood workshop and tiny showroom. Visitors can browse finished tableware, watch weekday production, or book a calm two-hour introductory class.

profileValues.borough-city-guide.places.curator-note: Drop-in browsing is welcome, but reserve the Saturday wheel session ahead. The seconds shelf near the kiln holds the best useful souvenirs.

media.alt: Ceramic artist shaping clay at the wheel inside a plant-filled neighborhood studio

listings.title: Ember House
listings.summary: A candlelit neighborhood dining room built around a wood oven and shared plates.
listings.description: Ember House serves a compact evening menu from a brick corner room. Vegetables, flatbreads, and a few larger plates come from the open hearth, with unfussy bottles chosen for the table.

profileValues.borough-city-guide.places.curator-note: Ask for the small back table if you want a quieter dinner. Two people can make a meal from three shared plates and whatever is coming from the oven.

media.alt: Warm restaurant exterior with diners gathered beneath trees at dusk

listings.title: Riverlight Baths
listings.summary: A cedar sauna and open-air river bath for unhurried resets near the water.
listings.description: Riverlight pairs two cedar saunas with a sheltered river deck and cool-water steps. Timed sessions keep the space calm, and sunset bookings follow the skyline into evening.

profileValues.borough-city-guide.places.curator-note: Book the last daylight session and bring sandals with grip. The middle sauna runs gentler and is a good first stop before the river steps.

media.alt: Cedar river bathhouse and swimming steps beside the city skyline at sunset

listings.title: Songbird Records
listings.summary: A friendly record shop with deep local bins and listening stations that invite a pause.
listings.description: Songbird keeps new releases near the door and a carefully labeled used collection along the long wall. Weekend selectors play short sets without turning the shop into an event venue.

profileValues.borough-city-guide.places.curator-note: Start with the staff's five-record listening shelf. The local section is filed by year, which makes an unexpectedly good map of the city's music.

media.alt: Listener browsing vinyl records in a small independent music shop

listings.title: Courtyard Cinema
listings.summary: A repertory cinema that moves outdoors beneath string lights when the weather cooperates.
listings.description: Courtyard Cinema screens restorations, documentaries, and regional work in a converted hall. Summer programs move into the brick courtyard with folding chairs and a compact projection booth.

profileValues.borough-city-guide.places.curator-note: For courtyard screenings, arrive twenty minutes early and choose a chair along the ivy wall. Indoor matinees are the calmest way to see the same program.

media.alt: Audience watching a black-and-white film in a brick courtyard under string lights

listings.title: Borough Market Hall
listings.summary: A leafy public market being prepared for a future guide update.
listings.description: This representative draft keeps an unpublished place and its photography available to operators without exposing either on public BOROUGH surfaces.

profileValues.borough-city-guide.places.curator-note: This note is intentionally private while the operator verifies market hours and access details before publication.
